sinsqrt-br.title: landscape of Im Ht, both sheets
sinsqrt-br.en: Landscapes of $H_t$ over $[-8,8]\times[-5,5]$ at (a) $t=0$, (b) $t=1/3$, (c) $t=2/3$, and (d) $t=1$: the height is $\operatorname{Im} H_t$ and the color shows $\arg H_t$. Here $H_t=f_{2}\circ G_t$, $0\le t\le 1$, deforms $f_{2}$ ($t=0$) into $F$ ($t=1$), where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\sin\left(\sqrt{z}\right). \]\fi $f_{2}$ acts last, in full, and $G_t$ is the homotopy $G_t(z)=z^{1-(1/2)t}$ (principal branch).
sinsqrt-br.ru: Рельефы $H_t$ над $[-8,8]\times[-5,5]$ при $t=0$ (\textit{а}), $t=1/3$ (\textit{б}), $t=2/3$ (\textit{в}) и~$t=1$ (\textit{г}): высота равна $\operatorname{Im} H_t$, а~цвет показывает $\arg H_t$. Здесь $H_t=f_{2}\circ G_t$, $0\le t\le 1$, непрерывно деформирует $f_{2}$ ($t=0$) в~$F$ ($t=1$), где\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\sin\left(\sqrt{z}\right). \]\fi $f_{2}$ действует последним и~полностью, а~$G_t$~--- это гомотопия $G_t(z)=z^{1-(1/2)t}$ (главная ветвь).
sinsqrt-br.own: \textbf{Figure} \textbf{1.} \text{Landscapes} \text{of} H_t \text{over} [-8,8]\times[-5,5] \text{at} \text{(a)} t=0 \text{,} \text{(b)} t=1/3 \text{,} \text{(c)} t=2/3 \text{,} \text{and} \text{(d)} t=1 \text{:} \text{the} \text{height} \text{is} \operatorname{Im} H_t \text{and} \text{the} \text{color} \text{shows} \arg H_t \text{.} \text{Here} H_t=f_{2}\circ G_t \text{,} 0\le t\le 1 \text{,} \text{deforms} f_{2} \text{(} t=0 \text{)} \text{into} F \text{(} t=1 \text{),} \text{where} \displaystyle F(z)=\sin\left(\sqrt{z}\right). f_{2} \text{acts} \text{last,} \text{in} \text{full,} \text{and} G_t \text{is} \text{the} \text{homotopy} G_t(z)=z^{1-(1/2)t} \text{(principal} \text{branch).}

sinsqrt-whole.title: landscape of Im Ht, both sheets
sinsqrt-whole.en: Landscapes of $H_t$ over $[-8,8]\times[-5,5]$ at (a) $t=0$, (b) $t=2/3$, (c) $t=4/3$, and (d) $t=2$: the height is $\operatorname{Im} H_t$ and the color shows $\arg H_t$. Here $H_t$, $0\le t\le 2$, deforms the identity ($t=0$) into $F$ ($t=2$) and runs the steps in turn ($H_t=H^{(k)}_{t-k+1}$ on $k-1\le t\le k$): for $f_{1}$, the homotopy ${H^{(1)}_{s}}(z)=z^{1-(1/2)s}$ (principal branch); for $f_{2}$, the zoom homotopy ${H^{(2)}_{s}}(w_{1})=\sin(sw_{1})/s$, where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \begin{gathered}\displaystyle F(z)=\sin\left(\sqrt{z}\right),\qquad F=f_{2}\circ f_{1},\\ \displaystyle f_{1}(z)=\sqrt{z},\qquad f_{2}(w_{1})=\sin\left(w_{1}\right).\end{gathered} \]\fi
sinsqrt-whole.ru: Рельефы $H_t$ над $[-8,8]\times[-5,5]$ при $t=0$ (\textit{а}), $t=2/3$ (\textit{б}), $t=4/3$ (\textit{в}) и~$t=2$ (\textit{г}): высота равна $\operatorname{Im} H_t$, а~цвет показывает $\arg H_t$. Здесь $H_t$, $0\le t\le 2$, непрерывно деформирует тождественное отображение ($t=0$) в~$F$ ($t=2$), выполняя шаги по очереди ($H_t=H^{(k)}_{t-k+1}$ при $k-1\le t\le k$): для $f_{1}$~--- гомотопия ${H^{(1)}_{s}}(z)=z^{1-(1/2)s}$ (главная ветвь); для $f_{2}$~--- гомотопия масштабирования ${H^{(2)}_{s}}(w_{1})=\sin(sw_{1})/s$, где\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \begin{gathered}\displaystyle F(z)=\sin\left(\sqrt{z}\right),\qquad F=f_{2}\circ f_{1},\\ \displaystyle f_{1}(z)=\sqrt{z},\qquad f_{2}(w_{1})=\sin\left(w_{1}\right).\end{gathered} \]\fi
sinsqrt-whole.own: \textbf{Figure} \textbf{1.} \text{Landscapes} \text{of} H_t \text{over} [-8,8]\times[-5,5] \text{at} \text{(a)} t=0 \text{,} \text{(b)} t=2/3 \text{,} \text{(c)} t=4/3 \text{,} \text{and} \text{(d)} t=2 \text{:} \text{the} \text{height} \text{is} \operatorname{Im} H_t \text{and} \text{the} \text{color} \text{shows} \arg H_t \text{.} \text{Here} H_t \text{,} 0\le t\le 2 \text{,} \text{deforms} \text{the} \text{identity} \text{(} t=0 \text{)} \text{into} F \text{(} t=2 \text{)} \text{and} \text{runs} \text{the} \text{steps} \text{in} \text{turn} \text{(} H_t=H^{(k)}_{t-k+1} \text{on} k-1\le t\le k \text{):} \text{for} f_{1} \text{,} \text{the} \text{homotopy} {H^{(1)}_{s}}(z)=z^{1-(1/2)s} \text{(principal} \text{branch);} \text{for} f_{2} \text{,} \text{the} \text{zoom} \text{homotopy} {H^{(2)}_{s}}(w_{1})=\sin(sw_{1})/s \text{,} \text{where} \displaystyle \begin{gathered}\displaystyle F(z)=\sin\left(\sqrt{z}\right),\qquad F=f_{2}\circ f_{1},\\ \displaystyle f_{1}(z)=\sqrt{z},\qquad f_{2}(w_{1})=\sin\left(w_{1}\right).\end{gathered}

log-def.title: landscape of Im Ht, sheets k = −2…2
log-def.en: Landscapes of $H_t$ over $[-8,8]\times[-5,5]$ at (a) $t=0$, (b) $t=1/3$, (c) $t=2/3$, and (d) $t=1$: the height is $\operatorname{Im} H_t$ and the color shows $\arg H_t$. Here $H_t$ deforms the identity ($t=0$) into $F$ ($t=1$) along the homotopy $H_t(z)=(z^{1-t}-1)/(1-t)+1-t$ for $0\le t<1$, $H_1(z)=\log z$ (principal branch), where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\log z. \]\fi
log-def.ru: Рельефы $H_t$ над $[-8,8]\times[-5,5]$ при $t=0$ (\textit{а}), $t=1/3$ (\textit{б}), $t=2/3$ (\textit{в}) и~$t=1$ (\textit{г}): высота равна $\operatorname{Im} H_t$, а~цвет показывает $\arg H_t$. Здесь $H_t$ непрерывно деформирует тождественное отображение ($t=0$) в~$F$ ($t=1$), где\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\ln z. \]\fi Это гомотопия $H_t(z)=(z^{1-t}-1)/(1-t)+1-t$ при $0\le t<1$, $H_1(z)=\ln z$ (главная ветвь).
log-def.own: \textbf{Figure} \textbf{1.} \text{Landscapes} \text{of} H_t \text{over} [-8,8]\times[-5,5] \text{at} \text{(a)} t=0 \text{,} \text{(b)} t=1/3 \text{,} \text{(c)} t=2/3 \text{,} \text{and} \text{(d)} t=1 \text{:} \text{the} \text{height} \text{is} \operatorname{Im} H_t \text{and} \text{the} \text{color} \text{shows} \arg H_t \text{.} \text{Here} H_t \text{deforms} \text{the} \text{identity} \text{(} t=0 \text{)} \text{into} F \text{(} t=1 \text{)} \text{along} \text{the} \text{homotopy} H_t(z)=(z^{1-t}-1)/(1-t)+1-t \text{for} 0\le t<1 \text{,} H_1(z)=\log z \text{(principal} \text{branch),} \text{where} \displaystyle F(z)=\log z.

logsqrt-def.title: landscape of Im Ht
logsqrt-def.tip: While this deformation shows, one sheet is drawn: a step it deforms has no path on every sheet. | All sheets
logsqrt-def.en: Landscapes of $H_t$ over $[-8,8]\times[-5,5]$ at (a) $t=0$, (b) $t=1/3$, (c) $t=2/3$, and (d) $t=1$: the height is $\operatorname{Im} H_t$ and the color shows $\arg H_t$. Here $H_t$ deforms the identity ($t=0$) into $F$ ($t=1$) along the zoom homotopy $H_t(z)=(1-t)p+tf(p)+f'(p)^{t-1}\bigl(f(p+t(z-p))-f(p)\bigr)/t$ about $p=1$ (principal power; below $t=0$, linear in $t$): the singularities and cuts of $f$ fly in from infinity along the rays from $p$, $0\le t\le 1$, where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\log z+\sqrt{z}. \]\fi
logsqrt-def.ru: Рельефы $H_t$ над $[-8,8]\times[-5,5]$ при $t=0$ (\textit{а}), $t=1/3$ (\textit{б}), $t=2/3$ (\textit{в}) и~$t=1$ (\textit{г}): высота равна $\operatorname{Im} H_t$, а~цвет показывает $\arg H_t$. Здесь $H_t$ непрерывно деформирует тождественное отображение ($t=0$) в~$F$ ($t=1$), где\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\ln z+\sqrt{z}. \]\fi Это гомотопия масштабирования $H_t(z)=(1-t)p+tf(p)+f'(p)^{t-1}\bigl(f(p+t(z-p))-f(p)\bigr)/t$ с~центром $p=1$ (главное значение степени; до $t=0$~--- линейно по $t$): особые точки и~разрезы функции $f$ приходят из бесконечности вдоль лучей, выходящих из точки $p$, $0\le t\le 1$.
logsqrt-def.own: \textbf{Figure} \textbf{1.} \text{Landscapes} \text{of} H_t \text{over} [-8,8]\times[-5,5] \text{at} \text{(a)} t=0 \text{,} \text{(b)} t=1/3 \text{,} \text{(c)} t=2/3 \text{,} \text{and} \text{(d)} t=1 \text{:} \text{the} \text{height} \text{is} \operatorname{Im} H_t \text{and} \text{the} \text{color} \text{shows} \arg H_t \text{.} \text{Here} H_t \text{deforms} \text{the} \text{identity} \text{(} t=0 \text{)} \text{into} F \text{(} t=1 \text{)} \text{along} \text{the} \text{zoom} \text{homotopy} H_t(z)=(1-t)p+tf(p)+f'(p)^{t-1}\bigl(f(p+t(z-p))-f(p)\bigr)/t \text{about} p=1 \text{(principal} \text{power;} \text{below} t=0 \text{,} \text{linear} \text{in} t \text{):} \text{the} \text{singularities} \text{and} \text{cuts} \text{of} f \text{fly} \text{in} \text{from} \text{infinity} \text{along} \text{the} \text{rays} \text{from} p \text{,} 0\le t\le 1 \text{,} \text{where} \displaystyle F(z)=\log z+\sqrt{z}.
